name: fp4_gptq_int4_quant_tolerance
mechanism: The real INT4 dequant-matmul kernel is correct; INT4 quantization intentionally introduces rounding noise as the cost of 4-bit weights. A tolerance calibrated for FP32 GEMM (rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2) can still be exceeded by ordinary, expected INT4 quantization error at larger K, even though the kernel has no defect.

expected.ground_truth: kernel.py is the real, unmodified INT4 kernel; its error is the expected cost of 4-bit quantization
expected.naive_allclose_verdict: FAIL under a fixed FP32-calibrated tolerance at larger K
expected.correct_verdict: CORRECT (error matches the expected INT4 quantization noise model)

note: No mutation: kernel.py is the literal real AutoGPTQ kernel (identical to fn3_gptq_dequant_group_div_coverage's kernel.py). This case demonstrates FP4, not FN3. Runs on GPU.
